notes.title: A celebration in honor of the sales of 100 copies of the game.
notes.content:
Night Star - I have great news. 103 people have already bought our game.

Moore- Hooray, we have to celebrate this! Let's fly into the cake!

Klay - I'm very happy too, but, Moore, please be careful!

Night Star - Sometimes I'm ashamed of her...

Nor - ...

Moore -Hey, it seems that Nor has grabbed the biggest piece for himself!

Night Star -No matter how much we all have to deal with the consequences of your glee, Moore.

Klay- What, a salad? Moore, where's my cake?!
